# Support

Thanks for taking the time to report a problem. A clear report with the log is
the fastest route to an answer.

## Before you ask

Collect:

- the Posnic version shown in **About** or on the latest release;
- the operating system and whether it is 64-bit;
- what you did, what you expected, and what happened; and
- the application log. It is written directly under Electron's user-data
  directory, not in a separate `logs` folder.

| System  | Log                                            |
| ------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| Windows | `%APPDATA%\posnic\app.log`                     |
| macOS   | `~/Library/Application Support/posnic/app.log` |
| Linux   | `~/.config/posnic/app.log`                     |

Remove customer records, card or bank details, credentials, tax identifiers,
and production database files before attaching anything to a public report.

## Where to ask

- **Something is broken, or the app will not start:** open a normal issue in
  this repository. Say what you did, what happened, and attach the log.
- **A question about how to use Posnic:** ask in this repository's discussions
  or the support channel supplied with your distribution.
- **A security problem:** do not open a public issue. Use the private contact
  supplied with your distribution and see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
- **A data-loss or money-affecting problem:** say so in the first line of the
  report. It is treated as the highest non-security priority.
- **Paid or distributor support:** use the contact supplied with your
  distribution.

Posnic is free software. Nobody is obliged to answer, and this page is not a
service-level agreement. The supported versions and the response we intend to
provide are described in [SUPPORT_LIFECYCLE.md](../docs/SUPPORT_LIFECYCLE.md).

The full operator guide, including recovery and printer setup, is
[USER_GUIDE.md](../docs/USER_GUIDE.md).
